Selected cover reference on games table

takeaways.finding: Rating quality, rating activity, and PopScore visibility are distinct signals.
takeaways.interpretation: Keep quality, confidence/activity, and visibility separate.

takeaways.finding: Low-visibility, high-quality candidates were identified within the quality cohort.
takeaways.evidence: 231 quality-cohort games satisfy rating >= 80, reliable evidence, main-game, PopScore-known, and within-year quality-cohort visibility <= 40%.
takeaways.interpretation: The list is an auditable within-sample diagnostic artifact, not a market-wide hidden-gem estimate or prescriptive ranking score.

takeaways.finding: Some categories are enriched in the quality cohort relative to the residual comparison cohort.
takeaways.evidence: 334 enrichment tests are significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
takeaways.interpretation: These reflect the curated extraction design, not direct quality effects, causal effects, or market prevalence estimates.

takeaways.finding: Platform reach and PopScore visibility can be compared separately from rating quality.
takeaways.interpretation: Platform count is a reach signal and may also reflect commercial visibility or release strategy.

takeaways.finding: User and critic reception are related but not identical.
takeaways.evidence: User-versus-critic Spearman rho=0.701; disagreement cases are exported separately.
takeaways.interpretation: Retain user-only, critic-only, and combined ratings as separate fields.
